about: Hand-typed vectors for a follow row that stays on one expiry date (M8.11, schema 2). Times are IST. Until 6 Dec 2026 every NFO contract trades to 15:40 on its expiry day; from 7 Dec 2026 an index contract stops at 15:30 and a stock contract at 15:45; a special session day takes its close from the market calendar.

cases.name: a date that is listed and open gives its own expiry, not the nearest
until 6 Dec 2026 an index contract is open at 15:39:59 on its day
at 15:40 it has expired, and the row does not move to the next expiry
from 7 Dec 2026 an index contract is open at 15:29:59
a stock contract trades to 15:45 from 7 Dec 2026
a date that is not in today's contract list
a date already past and no longer listed says it has expired
a special session day is open until the calendar's close
and has expired at that close

words.text: 24 Nov has expired. This row stays on that date: remove it, or change it to follow the nearest expiry.
NIFTY has no 25 Nov expiry in today's contract list.

refused.name: a future row follows the month
refused.text: A future row follows the month. Add a dated future to the list as a symbol.

refused.name: the date rule needs its date
refused.text: Pick the date this row stays on.

refused.name: a date written another way is not one
refused.text: Pick the date this row stays on.
